headline: Senate advances Protect College Sports Act with cloture votes pending while student athlete NIL rights hang in the balance!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate voted 77-22 to proceed with debate on the Protect College Sports Act (S. 4668), which aims to regulate student athlete name, image, and likeness rights. Multiple amendments from Senator Thune were filed as the chamber worked through the bill's contentious provisions, with cloture votes scheduled for next week. The Senate also confirmed federal judge Kasdin Miller Mitchell 49-45 and passed resolutions honoring Dolly Parton and Central Asian independence.
